comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: A country with almost no concept of money, taxes, or buying land (since land belongs to the clan), constantly battered by storms and earthquakes, yet ranks FIRST IN THE WORLD for happiness! While we work our entire lives to buy 'security' and a house, they are born already holding them. Vanuatu truly makes us question: What are we actually chasing? How do you define wealth after watching this? 🇻🇺🌿
